name: @banza/banzai-api
description: BanzAI knowledge API — subordinate, non-authoritative. Explains protocol rules and cites sources; never certifies, decides, or substitutes the conformance suite. Runs offline with a deterministic mock provider (no external LLM, no GPU, no model downloads).

scripts.eval: node eval/gen-grounded-dataset.mjs --check && node eval/run-grounded-eval.mjs && node eval/parity-grounded.mjs
scripts.eval:canonical: node eval/gen-canonical-eval.mjs --check && node eval/canonical-reconciliation.mjs --check && node eval/canonical-metrics.mjs --check
scripts.eval:canonical:gen: node eval/gen-canonical-eval.mjs && node eval/canonical-reconciliation.mjs && node eval/canonical-metrics.mjs
